A career coach targeting Chinese-speaking professionals uses the book's learning-loop framework as free lead-magnet content to sell paid coaching.

money_ideas.idea: The author's own path: sell paid workshops, coaching, or a companion paid course built on the free book's audience.

steal_this: Not a buildable weekend product for a third party — it's a personal book with an author's own brand and business ties baked in. Honest take: skip it unless you're targeting the same Chinese-language self-improvement audience with your own original content.
